exposure: Gestational weight gain less than IOM recommendations after GDM diagnosis
weight gain after diagnosis of GDM
Gestational weight gain greater than IOM recommendations after GDM diagnosis
Gestational weight gain within Institute of Medicine (IOM) recommendations after gestational diabetes (GDM) diagnosis
Gestational weight gain category (within, less than, or greater than IOM recommendations)
finding: Weight gain exceeding IOM recommendations per week of gestation after a GDM diagnosis is associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preeclampsia, cesarean delivery, A2 GDM, macrosomia, and LGA.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery risk was increased in those gaining above IOM recommendations compared to those within.
